slots.name: North Carolina gasoline price
slots.sentence: The U.S. average price of a gallon of regular gas was $4.49 on May 18, a day before Berger made his comment, according to the U.S. Energy Information Administration. That’s 3% higher than it was on Monday. AAA records show regular gas in North Carolina averages about $4.12 per gallon, which is lower than what they were on May 19: $4.17 per gallon.
